parameters.label: Gold Settings
parameters.description: Configure Gold for the plugin surface.

fields.label: Gold Max
fields.description: Configure GoldMax for the Gold surface.
fields.context: Maximum party gold applied by Change Gold and gainGold/loseGold: the resulting amount is clamped between 0 and this value. It does not automatically rewrite a loaded balance until a gold change. An absent whole Gold parameter uses its group default 999999999; a stored Gold struct missing GoldMax uses this child default 99999999. An explicit stored value wins.

fields.label: Gold Font Size
fields.description: Configure GoldFontSize for the Gold surface.
fields.context: Font size in pixels used by Window_Base.drawCurrencyValue and the item-style Window_Gold, including the native menu/shop gold window. Does not change arbitrary text that merely mentions gold.

fields.label: Gold Icon
fields.description: Configure GoldIcon for the Gold surface.
fields.context: Icon index in img/system/IconSet.png. A positive value replaces the standard currency unit with that icon in normal currency drawing; item-style Window_Gold shows both icon and unit. Zero disables the icon and displays the currency unit text. Applies when the drawn unit is the game currency.

fields.label: Gold Overlap
fields.description: Configure GoldOverlap for the Gold surface.
fields.context: Literal fallback text drawn instead of the number when the measured currency amount exceeds its available width, for example A Lot or MAX. This is free text, not an enum or an overlap mode; it does not change the actual gold balance.

fields.label: Item Style
fields.description: Configure ItemStyle for the Gold surface.
fields.context: In the standard Window_Gold, true draws the currency icon and unit at the left and the amount at the right, like an inventory row. False retains the normal layout with the unit/icon at the right of the amount. Applies only when the window uses the game currency unit.

parameters.context: Configures the party gold cap and currency presentation. An absent whole Gold parameter uses this group default (GoldMax 999999999); a stored struct missing GoldMax uses the child default 99999999. An explicitly stored child value wins. CLI get returns the effective decoded object. To preserve siblings, set a child path such as /Gold/GoldMax; replacing /Gold requires all fields. See each child for overflow text and item-style layout.

parameters.description: QoL

fields.label: ShortcutScripts
fields.description: Expose helpers and current scene/event/battle context as globals.
fields.context: When enabled at boot, provides script globals: $scene (current scene), $spriteset (its spriteset, possibly undefined), $subject/$targets/$target (battle context, undefined outside battle), and $event (deepest running map interpreter event, otherwise undefined). $commonEvent(1) queues Common Event 1 normally; $onceParallel(1) launches it once in parallel on the current map. Use in a Script event command, with existing Common Event IDs and a map scene for the parallel helper. Disabling prevents registration; these names are runtime helpers, not CLI commands.

fields.label: EncounterRateMinimum
fields.description: Minimum added to the two encounter random draws; map notes can override it.
fields.context: Adds a minimum in encounter-counter steps: count=randomInt(mapEncounterStep)+randomInt(mapEncounterStep)+minimum. Each randomInt draws from 0 through step-1. The native walking conditions and encounter progress still apply. Override in Map Properties > Note with <MINIMUM ENCOUNTER STEPS: 20> (nonnegative integer).

fields.label: NoTileShadows
fields.description: Hide tile shadow geometry unless the map explicitly shows shadows.
fields.context: True hides tile shadow geometry by default. In Map Properties > Note, <SHOW TILE SHADOWS> forces shadows visible and has priority over <HIDE TILE SHADOWS>; the latter hides them even when this default is false. Does not remove map tiles or character shadows.

fields.label: SmartEventCollisionPriority
fields.description: Only normal-priority events obstruct other normal-priority events.

fields.label: AnimationMirrorOffset
fields.description: Mirror the animation database X offset when the animation is mirrored.
fields.context: Controls horizontal offset mirroring for MZ particle animations. In Database > Animations > Name, <MIRROR OFFSET X> forces it on and has priority over <NO MIRROR OFFSET X>, which forces it off; otherwise this parameter applies. When enabled, offsetX changes sign only when the animation itself is mirrored.

fields.label: MvAnimationRate
fields.description: MV frames per animation cell, from 1 to 10; Effekseer is unchanged.
fields.context: MV-format animation update interval in game frames, clamped to 1..10; smaller values play faster. In Database > Animations > Name, <RATE: 2> overrides this default for that animation. The tag accepts nonnegative digits, with 0 treated as 1.

fields.label: AutoStretch
fields.description: Initial game stretch mode; default delegates to RPG Maker.
fields.context: Initial canvas scaling: stretch fits the available browser area while preserving aspect ratio; normal uses the engine default scale (normally 1) without fitting. default delegates the initial choice to the MZ engine. This does not change game resolution or stretch axes independently.

fields.label: PixelateImageRendering
fields.description: Use nearest-neighbor bitmap scaling and pixelated CSS presentation.

fields.label: AntiZoomPictures
fields.description: Compensate picture scale and position when spriteset scale changes; translation-only frames retain the previous adjustment.

fields.label: DetachMapPictureContainer
fields.description: Parent map pictures to the scene above the timer, outside spriteset zoom and filters.

fields.label: DetachBattlePictureContainer
fields.description: Parent battle pictures to the scene above the timer, outside spriteset zoom and filters.

fields.label: FontShadows
fields.description: Draw the outline color as a two-pixel text shadow instead of a stroke.

fields.label: FontSmoothing
fields.description: True sets CSS font-smooth:none when centering game elements; false leaves the existing style unchanged.
fields.context: This flag does not guarantee smoother text: its true branch writes the CSS value none. Browser support determines whether that property has a visual effect. It does not change Bitmap.smooth or the font file; false does not actively restore another CSS value.

fields.label: FontWidthFix
fields.description: Preserve fractional canvas text widths in Message windows; standard Bitmap measurement rounds up.

fields.label: DigitGroupingStandardText
fields.description: Group numeric text in standard window drawing.
fields.context: Controls ordinary Window_Base.drawText, such as menu values and labels. True formats numbers; false leaves that surface ungrouped. Uses /QoL/DigitGroupingLocale (default en-US): 12345 becomes 12,345 for en-US and 12.345 for pt-BR. Up to six fractional digits are retained. Leading-zero numeric strings and digits inside [] or <> are preserved; {{12345}} emits ungrouped 12345.

fields.label: DigitGroupingExText
fields.description: Group numeric text after native escape conversion when creating a text state.
fields.context: Controls Window_Base.createTextState after escape conversion, including Show Text and drawTextEx-based help/choice/plugin windows. True formats numbers; false leaves that surface ungrouped. Uses /QoL/DigitGroupingLocale (default en-US): 12345 becomes 12,345 for en-US and 12.345 for pt-BR. Up to six fractional digits are retained. Leading-zero numeric strings and digits inside [] or <> are preserved; {{12345}} emits ungrouped 12345.

fields.label: DigitGroupingDamageSprites
fields.description: Group the absolute damage value before creating glyph sprites.
fields.context: Controls numeric battle damage popups, formatting the absolute damage value before creating character sprites. True formats numbers; false leaves that surface ungrouped. Uses /QoL/DigitGroupingLocale (default en-US): 12345 becomes 12,345 for en-US and 12.345 for pt-BR. Up to six fractional digits are retained. Leading-zero numeric strings and digits inside [] or <> are preserved; {{12345}} emits ungrouped 12345.

fields.label: DigitGroupingGaugeSprites
fields.description: Group values drawn in HP, MP and TP gauge sprites.
fields.context: Controls current HP/MP/TP numbers drawn by Sprite_Gauge; it does not change gauge values or fill proportions. True formats numbers; false leaves that surface ungrouped. Uses /QoL/DigitGroupingLocale (default en-US): 12345 becomes 12,345 for en-US and 12.345 for pt-BR. Up to six fractional digits are retained. Leading-zero numeric strings and digits inside [] or <> are preserved; {{12345}} emits ungrouped 12345.

fields.label: Digit Grouping Locale
fields.description: Intl locale for digit grouping, maximum six fraction digits. Blank uses en-US; an invalid locale raises a runtime error.

fields.label: Map Name Text Codes
fields.description: Draw map names with native text codes, centered using the converted text width.
fields.context: True draws Map Properties > Display Name through drawTextEx and centers its measured width. Use native text codes, for example \C[2]Forest\C[0] or \I[1]Town; variables \V[1], actor names \N[1], party names \P[1], currency \G and font-size braces are handled by the engine. False uses the native plain map-name drawing. Plugin-specific codes require their corresponding text plugin.

fields.label: Subfolder Name Purge
fields.description: Normalize in-memory plugin names to trimmed basenames; asset paths and files remain intact.
fields.context: When true, a registry name containing / is normalized in memory to its final path segment with outer spaces trimmed: folder/MyPlugin becomes MyPlugin. Names without / are unchanged. This affects runtime plugin-name matching; it does not move files or rewrite js/plugins.js. Keep Coreto plugin filenames and load order required by their own installation contracts.

fields.label: Key Item Protection
fields.description: Configure KeyItemProtect for the QoLSettings surface.
fields.context: True prevents consuming key items through Game_Party.consumeItem and disables selling them in shops. False restores native consumption/sale rules. It does not block explicit Change Items events or arbitrary scripted inventory removal.

fields.label: Open Console on Boot
fields.description: Desktop developer console is unavailable in the browser; this legacy value has no runtime effect.

fields.label: F6: Toggle Sound
fields.description: Configure F6key for QoLSettings.
fields.context: Playtest only. F6 toggles BGM, BGS, ME and SE volume together between 0 and 100, choosing mute when current SE volume is nonzero. Saves ConfigManager immediately; it does not restore previous individual volume levels. Ctrl/Alt modifiers bypass F6. Start browser playtest with ?test in the URL; ForceNoPlayTest disables the playtest flag.

fields.label: F7: Toggle Fast Mode
fields.description: Configure F7key for QoLSettings.
fields.context: Playtest only. F7 toggles an extra map-main update while no message is busy, or an extra battle update while not entering battle commands and no message is busy; each extra update also updates Effekseer. This is normally two scene updates per frame, not a global timer/audio-speed setting, and composes with other map fast-forward behavior. Ctrl/Alt/Shift-modified F7 is ignored. Use ?test in the browser URL; ForceNoPlayTest disables the flag.

fields.label: CTRL + n: Quick Load
fields.description: Configure CtrlQuickLoad for QoLSettings.
fields.context: Playtest only: Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+9 (top row or numpad) load save slot 1 through 9 directly. Missing savefile metadata does nothing; load failure sounds the buzzer and returns to the prior scene. Loading an existing save replaces current game state. Use ?test in the browser URL; ForceNoPlayTest disables the playtest flag.

fields.label: Shift+R: Recover All
fields.description: Configure ShiftR_Toggle for QoLSettings.
fields.context: Playtest battle only: Shift+R calls recoverAll on every current party member, removing states and restoring HP/MP. TP is not set to maximum by this shortcut. It does nothing outside Scene_Battle or without Shift, and Ctrl/Alt bypass it. Use ?test in the browser URL; ForceNoPlayTest disables the playtest flag.

fields.label: Shift+T: Full TP
fields.description: Configure ShiftT_Toggle for QoLSettings.
fields.context: Playtest battle only: Shift+T fills TP for current party members through gainSilentTp(maxTp), bounded by each actor maximum. Does not restore HP/MP or remove states. It does nothing outside Scene_Battle or without Shift, and Ctrl/Alt bypass it. Use ?test in the browser URL; ForceNoPlayTest disables the playtest flag.

fields.label: Modern Controls
fields.description: Configure ModernControls for QoLSettings.
fields.context: True adds Home/End selection of first/last items and Shift+Up/Down page scrolling in movable selectable windows. PageUp/PageDown scroll when the window has no corresponding handler; ordinary arrow repeat remains available. Number-input windows opt out; touch behavior stays native. False uses the original cursor handler.

fields.label: Require Focus?
fields.description: Configure RequireFocus for QoLSettings.
fields.context: True delegates game-active status to the native engine focus check; false reports the game active even when the browser window loses focus. The browser may still throttle background tabs. If the entire QoL parameter is absent, its group default supplies false; a stored struct lacking this field uses child default true. An explicit stored value wins.

fields.label: Add Items in Battle Test
fields.description: Include named items in the native battle-test inventory.
fields.context: At battle-test setup, adds BTestAddedQuantity of each enabled database category to party inventory. Records must exist, have a name whose trimmed value does not compare <= 0 under JavaScript coercion, and not contain five consecutive hyphens. Thus empty/whitespace names, numeric zero/negative names and separator names containing ----- are skipped. Normal named records are included; inventory limits still apply. This does not add items during ordinary play.

fields.label: Add Weapons in Battle Test
fields.description: Include named weapons in the native battle-test inventory.
fields.context: At battle-test setup, adds BTestAddedQuantity of each enabled database category to party inventory. fields.description: Include named armors in the native battle-test inventory.
fields.context: At battle-test setup, adds BTestAddedQuantity of each enabled database category to party inventory. fields.label: Guaranteed Escape
fields.description: Set the escape probability to 100%; the battle must still permit escaping.

fields.label: Combined Accuracy
fields.description: Combine hit and evasion into one accuracy calculation for all action types.
fields.context: When true, itemHit=successRate/100*(subjectHitRate-targetEvaRate) and itemEva=0. Physical subjectHitRate uses subject.hit; other action types use 1. Same-side targets have zero evasion; opposing physical targets use eva, magical targets mev, and certain-hit targets 0. AccuracyBoost optionally adds 0.05 for actor physical hit, subtracts 0.05 from physical enemy evasion and forces item subjectHitRate to 1. The result is not clamped here. False retains the original hit/evasion functions.

fields.label: Player Accuracy Benefit
fields.description: Apply the Core accuracy benefit according to the action user and target.
fields.context: Used by ImprovedAccuracySystem. With both flags true, actor physical hit rate gains 0.05 and physical enemy evasion loses 0.05; item user hit rate is forced to 1. Effective hit chance is successRate/100 * (subjectHitRate-targetEvaRate); same-side targets have zero evasion, magical targets use mev. This calculation is not clamped here. With ImprovedAccuracySystem false, the native hit/evasion functions remain in use.

fields.label: Restore HP on Level Up
fields.description: Restore HP to maximum after levelUp, except during a class change.
fields.context: Applies when Game_Actor.levelUp runs, including upward Change Level events. Level decreases do not restore HP; internal levelUp calls during changeClass are excluded. Does not remove states or restore MP unless its separate option is enabled.

fields.label: Restore MP on Level Up
fields.description: Restore MP to maximum after levelUp, except during a class change.
fields.context: Applies when Game_Actor.levelUp runs, including upward Change Level events. Level decreases do not restore MP; internal levelUp calls during changeClass are excluded. Does not remove states or restore HP unless its separate option is enabled.

fields.label: Battle Test Quantity
fields.description: Quantity requested per included item; native inventory caps still apply.

fields.label: NewGameBoot
fields.description: On a test URL, start a new game directly after boot.
fields.context: When true and the engine test URL option is present, boot starts a new game directly on the map instead of the title screen. For browser playtest, append ?test to the game index URL (or &test after an existing query). This checks the URL test option even when ForceNoPlayTest clears Game_Temp playtest status.

fields.label: ForceNoPlayTest
fields.description: Disable Game_Temp playtest features while retaining the URL boot route.
fields.context: True clears Game_Temp.isPlaytest after initialization, disabling features gated by that flag, including F6/F7, quick load, Shift+R/T, playtest-only common event and engine debug checks using isPlaytest. It does not remove the URL option: ?test still triggers NewGameBoot when enabled. False preserves the engine playtest status.

fields.label: NewGameCommonEvent
fields.description: Reserve this Common Event first after a playtest new game; zero disables it.
fields.context: Existing Common Event ID reserved after new-game setup only when Game_Temp.isPlaytest is true; 0 disables it. Start a browser playtest with ?test in the game URL (or &test after another query); ForceNoPlayTest clears this flag and suppresses this event. NewGameCommonEventAll is queued afterwards if configured; the native map interpreter runs queued events.

fields.label: NewGameCommonEventAll
fields.description: Reserve this Common Event after every new game, following the playtest event; zero disables it.

parameters.context: Startup quality-of-life, input, presentation and playtest settings; consult each child for its scope. An absent whole QoL parameter uses this group default (RequireFocus false); a stored struct missing RequireFocus uses the child default true. Explicit stored children win. CLI get returns decoded JSON; replacing /QoL requires the complete object. Set a child path to preserve other settings.

parameters.label: jsQuickFunc

fields.label: FunctionName

parameters.label: Parameter Settings
parameters.description: Configure battler formulas, caps and crisis threshold.

default.XParameterFormula:
const id = arguments[0];
return (this.traitsSum(Game_BattlerBase.TRAIT_XPARAM, id) + this.xparamPlus(id)) * this.xparamRate(id) + this.xparamFlatBonus(id);
default.SParameterFormula:
const id = arguments[0];
return (this.traitsPi(Game_BattlerBase.TRAIT_SPARAM, id) + this.sparamPlus(id)) * this.sparamRate(id) + this.sparamFlatBonus(id);

fields.label: ConvertToBase
fields.description: Convert user/this basic parameter references in authored trait formulas to base values.
fields.context: Controls JavaScript trait-note formulas on battler trait objects (actors, classes, equipment, enemies and states). For example <JS ATK Plus: user.mhp * 0.1> uses this.paramBase(0) when true. The conversion rewrites whitespace-prefixed user/this.mhp,mmp,atk,def,mat,mdf,agi,luk and user/this.param(...) to the base getter before evaluation, avoiding recursive use of the final parameter. When false, those final references remain; whitespace-prefixed user. is still changed to this. This is a textual rewrite, not a general JavaScript parser; do not assume differently embedded expressions are converted.

fields.label: CrisisRate
fields.description: HP ratio strictly below which a living battler is in crisis.

fields.label: BasicParameterFormula
fields.description: Function body returning the computed parameter; arguments[0] is its native parameter ID.
fields.context: JavaScript function body called with this=the battler and arguments[0]=the numeric parameter ID: 0=MAXHP (maximum HP); 1=MAXMP (maximum MP); 2=ATK (attack); 3=DEF (defense); 4=MAT (magic attack); 5=MDF (magic defense); 6=AGI (agility); 7=LUK (luck). Return a numeric result. The basic parameter result is rounded; extra and special values are rates (1 means 100%). Results are cached until battler refresh or actor level-up; avoid recursively calling the same final parameter from its own formula.

fields.label: XParameterFormula
fields.description: Function body returning the computed parameter; arguments[0] is its native parameter ID.
fields.default:
const id = arguments[0];
return (this.traitsSum(Game_BattlerBase.TRAIT_XPARAM, id) + this.xparamPlus(id)) * this.xparamRate(id) + this.xparamFlatBonus(id);
fields.context: JavaScript function body called with this=the battler and arguments[0]=the numeric parameter ID: 0=HIT (hit rate); 1=EVA (evasion); 2=CRI (critical rate); 3=CEV (critical evasion); 4=MEV (magic evasion); 5=MRF (magic reflection); 6=CNT (counterattack); 7=HRG (HP regeneration); 8=MRG (MP regeneration); 9=TRG (TP regeneration). Return a numeric result. The basic parameter result is rounded; extra and special values are rates (1 means 100%). Results are cached until battler refresh or actor level-up; avoid recursively calling the same final parameter from its own formula.

fields.label: SParameterFormula
fields.description: Function body returning the computed parameter; arguments[0] is its native parameter ID.
fields.default:
const id = arguments[0];
return (this.traitsPi(Game_BattlerBase.TRAIT_SPARAM, id) + this.sparamPlus(id)) * this.sparamRate(id) + this.sparamFlatBonus(id);
fields.context: JavaScript function body called with this=the battler and arguments[0]=the numeric parameter ID: 0=TGR (target rate); 1=GRD (guard effect); 2=REC (recovery effect); 3=PHA (pharmacology); 4=MCR (MP cost rate); 5=TCR (TP charge rate); 6=PDR (physical damage rate); 7=MDR (magical damage rate); 8=FDR (floor damage rate); 9=EXR (experience rate). Return a numeric result. The basic parameter result is rounded; extra and special values are rates (1 means 100%). Results are cached until battler refresh or actor level-up; avoid recursively calling the same final parameter from its own formula.

fields.label: BasicActorParamMax0
fields.description: JavaScript cap formula for this basic parameter; zero uses Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
fields.context: Maximum MAXHP (maximum HP) for actor battlers, basic parameter ID 0. This is JavaScript source evaluated with this=the battler and arguments[0]=the ID. A result of 0 means Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Native Max traits may raise the cap; the result is cached until refresh. Supply a numeric expression such as "9999"; it does not change the base parameter or current HP/MP by itself.

fields.label: AutoScrollLockX
fields.description: Automatic map camera lock.
fields.context: Camera locks use map display coordinates in tiles, not screen pixels. Automatic locking applies on a non-looping axis only when the viewport covers a fractional tile count whose ceiling equals the map size. Map notes <SCROLL LOCK X> / <SCROLL LOCK Y> select the configured DisplayLock value; <SCROLL LOCK X: 0.5> / <SCROLL LOCK Y: 0.5> select an explicit tile coordinate. A bare tag takes precedence if both forms occur. Locks are applied while screen zoom scale is 1; map setup refreshes the derived rules. This flag enables the automatic condition on the X axis; explicit map note locks are independent of the flag.

fields.label: Enable Masking
fields.description: Enable Masking
fields.context: True uses native WindowLayer stencil masking so window shapes occlude overlapping windows. False renders their overlap without writing those window shapes to the stencil. This changes overlap compositing, not item clipping or window positions.

fields.label: Correct Skin Bleed
fields.description: Retained for editor compatibility; MZ 1.10 already supplies the corrected 95-pixel skin frame.

fields.label: Line Height
fields.description: Line Height
fields.context: Line height in pixels used by Window_Base and consumers of lineHeight(). Use a positive finite value, such as 36; no additional clamp is applied by this setting. This does not change the font size automatically.

fields.label: Item Padding
fields.description: Item Padding
fields.context: Horizontal content inset in pixels on each side of item text rectangles and the base text rectangle. 8 removes 16 pixels from the available text width. Use a nonnegative value smaller than half the item width; the setting itself does not clamp it.

fields.label: Back Opacity
fields.description: Legacy fallback; MZ 1.10 uses the database window opacity.
fields.context: Retained metadata; Coreto on MZ 1.10.0 does not read this setting for window background opacity. The engine uses Database > System > Advanced windowOpacity through Game_System.windowOpacity(). That engine value uses 0=transparent through 255=opaque. This field is not a local fallback when the database value is absent.

fields.label: Translucent Opacity
fields.description: Translucent Opacity
fields.context: Paint opacity used when Window_Base.changePaintOpacity(false) draws disabled/translucent content. Use 0 (invisible) through 255 (opaque); for example 160. Enabled painting uses 255. This affects contents drawing, not the window frame or background opacity.

fields.label: Window Opening Speed
fields.description: Window Opening Speed
fields.context: Amount added to or subtracted from openness per window update, whose range is 0=closed through 255=open. A positive speed of 32 takes about eight updates for a full transition. Zero stalls transitions; negative values move in the wrong direction. The setting is not clamped, while the window openness property clamps to 0..255.

fields.label: Column Spacing
fields.description: Column Spacing
fields.context: Gap in pixels between selectable-item columns: itemRect shifts X by half this value and subtracts it from item width. Use a nonnegative value smaller than item width; negative values overlap columns and there is no additional clamp.

fields.label: Row Spacing
fields.description: Row Spacing
fields.context: Gap in pixels between selectable-item rows: itemRect shifts Y by half this value and subtracts it from item height. Use a nonnegative value smaller than item height; negative values overlap rows and there is no additional clamp.

fields.label: Show Scroll Bar?
fields.description: Show Scroll Bar?

fields.label: Thickness
fields.description: Thickness
fields.context: Scrollbar thickness in pixels. CLI/schema minimum is 1; the runtime draws bars only when ShowScrollBar is true and thickness>0. Choose a thickness smaller than half the inner window dimensions because each bar bitmap loses two thickness units along its long dimension.

fields.label: Offset
fields.description: Offset
fields.context: Scrollbar offset in pixels outward from the contents edge: vertical bar X=padding+innerWidth+offset; horizontal bar Y=padding+innerHeight+offset. Positive moves right/down, negative moves inward. It does not change the scrolled content origin.

fields.label: Bar Body Color
fields.description: Bar Body Color
fields.context: Color of the scrollbar thumb: a windowskin palette-index string such as "0", or hex such as "#ffffff". Text "0" means palette entry 0, not transparent. Requires ShowScrollBar and scrollable overflow.

fields.label: Off Bar Color
fields.description: Off Bar Color
fields.context: Color of the scrollbar track behind its thumb: windowskin palette-index string or hex, for example "0" or "#000000". OffBarOpacity controls its paint opacity. The track is drawn only when the axis has scrollable overflow.

fields.label: Off Bar Opacity
fields.description: Off Bar Opacity
fields.context: Paint opacity of the scrollbar track, 0=transparent through 255=opaque; the authored schema accepts 1..255. The thumb is painted at 255 independently. It is not a duration or window opacity.

fields.label: Show Background?
fields.description: Show Background?

fields.label: Item Height Padding
fields.description: Item Height Padding
fields.context: Extra pixels added to the inherited selectable-item height. Positive values create taller rows; negative values shrink them. It does not change lineHeight or font size and is not clamped; keep the resulting item height positive.

fields.label: JS: Draw Background
fields.description: JS: Draw Background

fields.label: Duration Per Text
fields.description: Duration Per Text
fields.context: Update frames per raw string character for Window_TextPopup. Hold duration is ceil(text.length*DurationPerChat), clamped between MinDuration and MaxDuration. Escape-code characters count in text.length; this is not a count of visible glyphs. Opening/closing frames are separate. Example 3 gives 30 hold frames for ten characters before clamping.

fields.label: Minimum Duration
fields.description: Minimum Duration
fields.context: Minimum hold duration in update frames for Window_TextPopup; authored minimum 1. Hold duration is ceil(text.length*DurationPerChat) clamped to MinDuration..MaxDuration. Keep MinDuration <= MaxDuration. Opening/closing frames are additional.

fields.label: Maximum Duration
fields.description: Maximum Duration
fields.context: Maximum hold duration in update frames for Window_TextPopup; authored minimum 1. Hold duration is ceil(text.length*DurationPerChat) clamped to MinDuration..MaxDuration. Keep MaxDuration >= MinDuration. Opening/closing frames are additional.

parameters.context: Window geometry values use pixels; OpenSpeed uses openness units per update (0 closed, 255 open), and paint opacity uses 0..255. EnableMasking controls overlap stencil masking. DurationPerChat/MinDuration/MaxDuration control popup hold time in update frames. Consult each field context for bounds and consumers.

fields.label: Parameter Name

fields.label: Abbreviation
fields.description: Configure Abbreviation for the CustomParam surface.
fields.context: Unique battler property name, for example "energy". Read it as actor.energy; parameter lists and paramValueByName use the abbreviation case-insensitively. Avoid built-in battler properties and duplicate abbreviations, including case-only variants: the runtime defines a non-configurable getter and duplicate property definitions fail at boot. Use a valid JavaScript identifier without spaces.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Configure Icon for the CustomParam surface.
fields.context: Numeric icon index in img/system/IconSet.png, zero-based across 16 columns. Used for this custom parameter when Param.DrawIcons is true in parameter-list drawing. Example 160 is row 10, column 0. It does not create a new icon asset.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Configure Type for the CustomParam surface.
fields.context: integer rounds the ValueJS result with Math.round when the battler getter is read. float returns it unchanged; formatted parameter-list output displays float as a percentage, rounding value*100 and appending %. Example 0.25 displays as 25%, not 0.25. Neither mode adds automatic bounds.

fields.label: JS: Value
fields.description: Configure ValueJS for the CustomParam surface.
fields.context: JavaScript function body called with this=the battler each time its custom getter is read. Return a number; no arguments are supplied. Example "return this.level * 2;" is actor-specific. Use values common to actors and enemies if both will be read. Avoid reading the same custom getter recursively. Type=integer rounds the result; float preserves it.

items.description: One configured entry; all fields are editable in the plugin manager.
items.context: Defines computed battler properties, vocabulary and icons. Each entry needs a unique Abbreviation and numeric ValueJS return. These definitions do not create stored save values.

fields.label: Picture's Filename
fields.description: Configure PictureFilename for the TitlePictureButton surface.
fields.context: Image in img/pictures/, basename without .png. Install the asset before using its name; an empty filename has no visible button image. The sprite starts invisible outside the screen until its bitmap load callback runs OnLoadJS then PositionJS.

fields.label: Button URL
fields.description: Configure ButtonURL for the TitlePictureButton surface.
fields.context: URL data consumed by the default CallHandlerJS, which calls Coreto.CoreEngine.openURL(this._data.ButtonURL). Changing this field has no effect if a custom handler ignores it. Use a complete https:// URL such as "https://example.com". The helper calls window.open(url,"_blank"), plays the OK sound, and reports POPUP_BLOCKED if the browser refuses it; it does not validate allowed protocols.

fields.label: JS: Position

fields.default:

this.y = Graphics.height - this.bitmap.height - 20;

fields.context: JavaScript function body called once the button bitmap is ready, with this=Sprite_TitlePictureButton. It runs before PositionJS and before the click handler is bound. parameters.label: UI Settings
parameters.description: Configure UI for the plugin surface.

fields.label: Fade Speed
fields.description: Configure FadeSpeed for the UI surface.
fields.context: Scene transition fade duration in update frames, returned by Scene_Base.fadeSpeed(). 24 is approximately 0.4 seconds at 60 updates/second. Use a positive value. This is distinct from title picture-button opacity units per update.

fields.label: Box Margin
fields.description: Configure BoxMargin for the UI surface.
fields.context: Pixels removed from each edge of the Database advanced UI area: Graphics.boxWidth=uiAreaWidth-2*BoxMargin and boxHeight=uiAreaHeight-2*BoxMargin. Choose a nonnegative value that leaves positive dimensions. Does not change the full screen resolution. SideButtons checks the remaining horizontal space at boot.

fields.label: Command Window Width
fields.description: Configure CommandWidth for the UI surface.
fields.context: Main command-window width in pixels, returned by Scene_Base.mainCommandWidth() and used by default menu layout formulas. Schema minimum 1. Custom Rect callbacks can ignore it; it does not automatically resize every window.

fields.label: Bottom Help Window
fields.description: Configure BottomHelp for the UI surface.
fields.context: true selects bottom help-area placement in scene layouts using isBottomHelpMode(); false selects top. Default Rect callbacks honor this flag; custom callbacks with fixed coordinates may ignore it.

fields.label: Right Aligned Menus
fields.description: Configure RightMenus for the UI surface.
fields.context: true selects right-hand command/input placement for scene layouts using isRightInputMode(); false selects left. Default menu formulas honor it; it does not mirror fixed custom rectangles.

fields.label: Show Buttons
fields.description: Configure ShowButtons for the UI surface.
fields.context: Master visibility for Sprite_Button touch UI controls. false hides them and moves them outside the screen; true still requires their per-type flag and the native touchUI creation condition. Keyboard/gamepad input remains available. Does not govern TitlePicButtons or ButtonAssist text.

fields.label: Show Cancel Button
fields.description: Configure cancelShowButton for the UI surface.
fields.context: Per-type visibility flag for Sprite_Button controls of type cancel. false hides those controls; true permits them only when UI.ShowButtons is true and the native scene has created touchUI buttons. Does not disable the corresponding keyboard/gamepad action.

fields.label: Show Menu Button
fields.description: Configure menuShowButton for the UI surface.
fields.context: Per-type visibility flag for Sprite_Button controls of type menu. false hides those controls; true permits them only when UI.ShowButtons is true and the native scene has created touchUI buttons. Does not disable the corresponding keyboard/gamepad action.

fields.label: Show Page Up/Down
fields.description: Configure pagedownShowButton for the UI surface.
fields.context: Per-type visibility flag for Sprite_Button controls of type pageup and pagedown. false hides those controls; true permits them only when UI.ShowButtons is true and the native scene has created touchUI buttons. Does not disable the corresponding keyboard/gamepad action.

fields.label: Show Number Buttons
fields.description: Configure numberShowButton for the UI surface.
fields.context: Per-type visibility flag for Sprite_Button controls of type down, up, down2, up2 and ok. false hides those controls; true permits them only when UI.ShowButtons is true and the native scene has created touchUI buttons. Does not disable the corresponding keyboard/gamepad action.

fields.label: Button Area Height
fields.description: Configure ButtonHeight for the UI surface.
fields.context: Height in pixels of the scene touch-button area, returned by buttonAreaHeight(). Schema minimum 1. Used by native/default layouts and ButtonAssist when it occupies that area; this does not scale individual button images.

fields.label: Bottom Buttons
fields.description: Configure BottomButtons for the UI surface.
fields.context: true selects the bottom touch-button area through isBottomButtonMode(); false selects the top. SideButtons may place page/cancel controls in the side margins instead. Custom position callbacks can ignore the flag.

fields.label: Side Buttons
fields.description: Configure SideButtons for the UI surface.
fields.context: Allows the boot-time side layout when Graphics.width-Graphics.boxWidth-2*BoxMargin is at least four Sprite_Button block widths. Otherwise the normal top/bottom layout remains. Side layout moves cancel right of the UI and page buttons left, freeing the main vertical button area. It still requires native touchUI controls to exist.

fields.label: State Icons Non-Frame
fields.description: Configure StateIconsNonFrame for the UI surface.
fields.context: true renders each current state icon into its own icon-sized bitmap from IconSet; false uses the native sprite frame selection on the shared IconSet bitmap. This changes rendering, not the states selected, cycling timing, or icon count.

fields.label: Level -> EXP Gauge
fields.description: Configure LvExpGauge for the UI surface.
fields.context: true draws a 128-pixel experience-progress gauge behind the actor level in Window_StatusBase.drawActorLevel. Requires Param.ShowActorLevel=true and a window that draws actor level. Maximum level uses maxLvGauge colors; otherwise expGauge colors. Does not add a new level display where none is drawn.

fields.label: Parameter Arrow
fields.description: Configure ParamArrow for the UI surface.
fields.context: Literal text drawn between current and prospective equipment parameter values by Window_EquipStatus.drawRightArrow. Example "→". Uses drawText, so message escape codes are not expanded here.

fields.label: Class Names
fields.description: Configure TextCodeClassNames for the UI surface.
fields.context: true draws class names with drawTextEx, allowing supported text escapes such as \I[64]. false uses plain drawText and removes icon escapes \I[n] first. Affects Window_StatusBase.drawActorClass, not the database name itself.

fields.label: Nicknames
fields.description: Configure TextCodeNicknames for the UI surface.
fields.context: true draws actor nicknames with drawTextEx and supported text escapes. false draws the nickname as plain text without escape expansion. Affects Window_StatusBase.drawActorNickname, not stored actor nicknames.

parameters.context: Common scene geometry and presentation. Dimensions use pixels; FadeSpeed is a scene fade duration in update frames. ShowButtons is the touch-control master gate with per-type gates beneath it; native touchUI must also create the controls. SideButtons requires spare screen margin. Fixed custom layout callbacks can ignore position/width flags. Class/nickname escapes and state-icon rendering affect drawing only.

tags.description: Head/Header/Top; Foot/Footer/Bottom; Left/Right; Anchor X/Y or pair. Explicit pair overrides individual anchors.
tags.context: Author in Database Animations > Name (Animations.json name). Runtime reads the tag from that field; CLI writes it without executing the game or authored JavaScript. Anchor numbers are nonnegative ratios without a 0..1 clamp. X is ratio*sprite.width measured from the target sprite local origin (0 is that origin, not automatically its left edge); Y is (ratio-1)*(sprite.height*sprite.scale.y), so 0 is top and 1 is foot. An explicit pair overrides individual axis tags. The resulting point is transformed through the target sprite world transform. Head/Top and Foot/Bottom choose vertical bounds; Left/Right choose -width/2 or +width/2.

tags.label: Param Plus
tags.description: Numeric Plus modifier. First match per parameter and numeric format in each trait object; sources compose in runtime order.
tags.context: Author in Database Actors > Note (Actors.json note); or Database Classes > Note (Classes.json note); or Database Enemies > Note (Enemies.json note); or Database Weapons > Note (Weapons.json note); or Database Armors > Note (Armors.json note); or Database States > Note (States.json note). Runtime reads the tag from that field; CLI writes it without executing the game or authored JavaScript. With the shipped formulas, basic=(paramBase+paramPlus)*paramRate*paramBuffRate+paramFlatBonus, then clamped to paramMin/paramMax and rounded. Extra=(native xparam trait sum+xparamPlus)*xparamRate+xparamFlatBonus. Special=(native sparam trait product+sparamPlus)*sparamRate+sparamFlatBonus. Custom Param formula settings can change these relationships. Plus is added before rates; Flat after rates. Rate factors multiply (150%=1.5); extra/special Plus/Flat use rate units (10%=0.1). Basic Plus/Flat use stat points. Max selects the largest cap against the configured basic cap; numeric Max 0 means Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Traits are visited in battler.traitObjects() order; per object the first percent-format match, first decimal/numeric-format match, and first JS match for a stage are composed, so distinct formats can stack. Results cache until battler refresh/actor level-up.
